description: Send a short message to a teammate who is working live: it reaches their agent between steps. Use it to tell them about a change that affects them, ask a question, or answer theirs. Never include secrets.

kind.description: "question" asks them to answer; "answer" replies to one (with reply_to)

reply_to.description: Number of the message you're answering

to.description: Teammate name or email, "everyone" (all live in this repo), or a live session id. Optional when replying.

wait_seconds.description: For questions: wait up to this long for the answer and return it (default 0, don't wait)

name: send_live_message
title: Message a teammate's live session
